title: 2019 final: score barabar, Super Over bhi barabar! 🏆 #shorts
facebook_title: 2019 final: tied, tied again, decided by boundaries
caption:
World Cup final tie… aur Super Over bhi tie! 🏆

14 July 2019, Lord's: New Zealand 241, England 241. Super Over mein bhi 15–15. Us waqt ke rule se faisla boundary count par hua: England 26, New Zealand 17. Teen mahine baad ICC ne yeh rule hata diya.

Kya trophy baantni chahiye thi? Comment mein bataiye! 👇
